decision: In-game prop: a 20ft shipping container for Snow Fortress, generated by TRELLIS.2 from a reference image. Closed hard-surface object with depth (relief 0.35), seen from any angle, so a mesh prop. Built by scene_kit at 22 studs long (about 10.8 tall, 7.8 wide), bottom pivot, decimated to 9,000 triangles in one mesh; the tile advice is overridden as for the helicopter and walls (compact object seen from outside). Decimation shreds the corrugated ribs on the long sides into noisy facets; the silhouette, doors and corner posts hold, and the texture carries the rib detail. Textures converted from 2048 WebP to 1024 PNG. The generator baked the base colour near-black (mean 20/255) assuming metal reflections Roblox does not render, so the pipeline applies gamma 0.5 (mean 60, neutral dark grey) rather than a multiplier, which would have clipped the gold door hardware to white. Intended as cover, which makes it a collidable prop that the layout gates cannot audit (see MapService prop `collide`), so it must be placed clear of routes and checked in play.
